description: Adds task rename, context checks, and project ablation; restores OpenCode memory reading and fixes channel output
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- `task.py start` now stops you if `implement.jsonl` or `check.jsonl` has no entries, preventing sub-agents from running without spec context (pass `--allow-empty-context` to bypass). `task.py validate` also flags empty files, and sub-agents now state when no context was injected. (#573)
- New `task.py rename <task> <new-slug>` renames a task everywhere at once, updating its folder, `task.json`, and links. `task.py start` now records your git branch so `task.py archive` can check it, git worktrees detect identity properly, and `task.py create` makes clean empty jsonl files. (#578)
- You can now run `trellis ablate` to remove all Trellis files from your project and back them up outside the repo, and `trellis restore` to put them all back. (#538)
- If `add_session.py` stops partway through, running it again now picks up where it left off instead of leaving half-written records. (#577)
- `trellis mem` can read OpenCode sessions again by reading its database directly without extra dependencies. (#574)
- On OMP, adding your configured `prompt_injection.skip_keyword` to a prompt now tells Trellis to skip injecting workflow state for that turn. (#586)

**Bug Fixes:**
- `add_session.py` and `task.py archive` now commit only their own files, so they no longer sweep in other files you had staged in git. (#579)
- Trellis now works when `.trellis` is a symlink pointing outside the repository, instead of rejecting valid task paths. (#567)
- Task scripts now retry automatically when git's `index.lock` is held, and show clear error messages if a JSON file fails to parse. (#576)
- `trellis update` no longer keeps asking to update files that are already identical to the new template. (#575)
- The Pi extension now resolves the project root from the session's working directory instead of picking the wrong folder. (#581)
- The sub-agent context hook now refuses to read files outside the task folder (#584), and clearly reports unreadable active-task records instead of acting like no task exists (#544).
- Channel fixes: multi-byte text like Chinese no longer corrupts when split across reads (#569), event numbers keep counting after broken lines in `events.jsonl` (#564), output no longer cuts off when the supervisor exits (#542), and long Claude system prompts are passed as files to avoid command-length errors (#555).
- On OMP, task context injection now caps total size (marking oversized files as truncated or omitted) and refreshes when files change (#541), without injecting the same file twice (#540).
- On OpenCode, context injection no longer leaves injected text visible in the terminal interface or session history. (#563)
notes: `task.py start` and `task.py validate` now require curated `implement.jsonl` and `check.jsonl` files by default (pass `--allow-empty-context` to bypass). No file migrations required.
